scope: Published official plan pages, broadband consumer labels, official FAQ or promotion notice. NOT carrier checkout, customer eligibility, independent full-terms certification, or a price guarantee.
methodologicalNote: Values were researched from official public carrier material on November 2, 2026. The source pages can change without notice; recheck expiry, line count, taxes, fees, network coverage, eSIM/IMEI, financing and actual checkout before purchase. Review status stays unverified until an authorized human signs a separate full-terms ledger.
